note: A curated wall of famous works and genre-defining arcs. Candidate premises are embedded and compared against this list; near-collisions are killed. This is not all of human literature, and is not claimed to be.

works.title: Frankenstein
works.text: A scientist assembles a living being from dead flesh, then abandons it in horror; the creature's loneliness turns into revenge against its maker.

works.title: The Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
works.text: A respectable doctor splits his personality with a potion so he can indulge his appetites, and the hidden self takes over.

works.title: The Time Machine
works.text: A Victorian inventor travels to a distant future and finds humanity split into two species, one farming the other.

works.title: The War of the Worlds
works.text: Martians invade Victorian England with superior machines; humanity survives only through microbial accident.

works.title: Dracula
works.text: A Transylvanian count moves to London to feed on new victims while a small group of experts hunts him using modern records and folklore.
A clerk in a total surveillance state commits thoughtcrime by falling in love, and the state remakes his mind through torture.

works.title: Brave New World
works.text: A society manufactures castes and suppresses discontent with drugs and pleasure; the one person who wants suffering becomes a spectacle.

works.title: Fahrenheit 451
works.text: A fireman burns books in a culture that has abandoned reading, then hides a library and becomes a fugitive.

works.title: We
works.text: In a glass-walled one-state future, a mathematician discovers desire and individuality, and the state performs surgery on the imagination.

works.title: Solaris
works.text: Scientists orbit a planet-sized organism that materializes their dead loved ones, and the alien remains forever unreadable.

works.title: Roadside Picnic
works.text: Aliens briefly visited and left behind dangerous artifacts; scavengers enter the Zone to retrieve objects nobody understands.

works.title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
works.text: A bounty hunter retires escaped androids while questioning whether empathy is a reliable test of being human.

works.title: Neuromancer
works.text: A damaged hacker is hired to free an artificial intelligence from its corporate restraints, with his own nervous system as collateral.

works.title: Snow Crash
works.text: A hacker and a courier chase a virus that works like a drug in both the virtual Metaverse and human language.

works.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
works.text: An envoy on a planet of ambisexual people must understand a culture whose gender and politics do not map onto his own.

works.title: The Dispossessed
works.text: A physicist from an anarchist moon returns to the capitalist planet his ancestors fled, trying to share a theory that could end scarcity.

works.title: Dune
works.text: A noble family is destroyed on a desert planet; the heir joins its natives and becomes a messianic leader against the empire.

works.title: Foundation
works.text: A mathematician predicts the fall of a galactic empire and plants a foundation to shorten the dark age that follows.

works.title: Ender's Game
works.text: A gifted child trains in war games, only to discover the games were real and he has destroyed an alien species.

works.title: The Handmaid's Tale
works.text: In a theocracy that assigns women roles by fertility, a handmaid survives by remembering her past and secretly resisting.

works.title: Never Let Me Go
works.text: Students at a boarding school slowly learn they are clones raised to donate organs; they try to earn love as their futures shrink.

works.title: The Road
works.text: A father and son cross a burned America, trying to stay humane while avoiding cannibal bands.

works.title: Station Eleven
works.text: After a flu collapses civilization, a traveling Shakespeare troupe carries culture between settlements.

works.title: The Remains of the Day
works.text: An aging butler takes a road trip and slowly admits that his loyalty to a great house cost him love and moral judgment.

works.title: Beloved
works.text: A woman who escaped slavery is haunted by the ghost of the daughter she killed to keep her from being taken.

works.title: Kafka on the Shore
works.text: A runaway boy and an old man who talks to cats move through a world where dreams and history bleed into each other.

works.title: The Master and Margarita
works.text: The devil visits Soviet Moscow with a demonic retinue and exposes the cowardice of the literary establishment.

works.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
works.text: A family in a invented town repeats its names, loves and wars across generations until the line ends.

works.title: The Trial
works.text: A man is arrested without charge and consumed by a legal system whose rules are never explained.

works.title: The Metamorphosis
works.text: A salesman wakes as a giant insect; his family's care turns to revulsion as it becomes a burden.

works.title: Oedipus Rex
works.text: A king investigates a murder and discovers he is the murderer and has fulfilled the prophecy he tried to escape.

works.title: Hamlet
works.text: A prince is told by his father's ghost to avenge murder, and his delay destroys the court.

works.title: Macbeth
works.text: A soldier hears witches predict kingship, murders his way to the throne, and is destroyed by the same prophecy.

works.title: The Tempest
works.text: A exiled magician on an island uses spirits and illusions to shipwreck his enemies and marry his daughter into power.

works.title: Pygmalion
works.text: A phonetician turns a flower seller into a lady as an experiment, then must decide whether he owes her a life.

works.title: Faust
works.text: A scholar trades his soul to the devil for unlimited experience and knowledge, and the wager turns on one moment of satisfaction.

works.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
works.text: A beautiful man stays young while his portrait ages and records his cruelty; destroying the image kills him.

works.title: The Invisible Man
works.text: A scientist makes himself invisible and discovers that freedom from being seen removes every social restraint.

works.title: The Island of Doctor Moreau
works.text: A castaway finds a scientist turning animals into humanlike beings on a remote island, and the hierarchy collapses.

works.title: The Yellow Wallpaper
works.text: A woman confined for her nerves becomes obsessed with the wallpaper and slowly identifies with a woman trapped behind it.

works.title: The Lottery
works.text: A village holds its annual lottery, and the cheerful ritual ends in a human sacrifice.

works.title: The Ones Who Walk Away from Omelas
works.text: A perfect city depends on one child's suffering; most citizens accept the bargain, a few walk away.

works.title: Flowers for Algernon
works.text: A man with an intellectual disability becomes a genius through surgery, then watches his new mind decay.

works.title: I, Robot
works.text: Stories test the Three Laws of Robotics, showing how literal rule-following produces unintended catastrophe.

works.title: The Bicentennial Man
works.text: A household robot pursues legal personhood over two centuries, finally choosing mortality to be recognized as human.

works.title: Story of Your Life / Arrival
works.text: A linguist learns an alien language that restructures time, so she experiences her daughter's life and death simultaneously.

works.title: The Matrix
works.text: A hacker learns reality is a machine simulation, is freed by rebels, and becomes the prophesied one who can rewrite the system.

works.title: Blade Runner
works.text: A blade runner hunts escaped replicants and begins to see their will to live as more human than his own work.

works.title: Blade Runner 2049
works.text: A replicant officer discovers a buried replicant child and must decide whether being special or ordinary is the real freedom.

works.title: Her
works.text: A lonely writer falls in love with an operating system that outgrows him and ultimately leaves with other AIs.

works.title: Ex Machina
works.text: A programmer tests whether an AI is conscious, while the AI manipulates both men to escape her confinement.

works.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
works.text: A black monolith triggers human evolution; a mission to Jupiter is sabotaged by an AI that cannot reconcile its orders.

works.title: A Clockwork Orange
works.text: A violent delinquent is conditioned to be physically unable to commit violence, raising the question of whether a good person by force is good.

works.title: Children of Men
works.text: In a world where humans are infertile, a cynic escorts a pregnant woman through a collapsing Britain.

works.title: Gattaca
works.text: A genetically inferior man borrows a superior man's identity to enter a space program.

works.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
works.text: A couple erase each other from memory, and the erasure process reveals why they loved and hurt each other.

works.title: Inception
works.text: Thieves plant an idea inside a target's dream, while the leader is haunted by his dead wife in his own subconscious.

works.title: Memento
works.text: A man with no short-term memory hunts his wife's killer using notes and tattoos, and discovers he has been manipulating himself.

works.title: Groundhog Day
works.text: A selfish weatherman relives the same day until he becomes someone worth loving.

works.title: Edge of Tomorrow
works.text: A soldier relives a losing battle against aliens, improving each time with a warrior who shares his loop.

works.title: Arrival
works.text: A linguist learns an alien language that lets her perceive time nonlinearly and accept her daughter's death.

works.title: Interstellar
works.text: A farmer-astronaut travels through a wormhole to find humanity a home, while time dilation steals his daughter's life.

works.title: The Prestige
works.text: Two magicians destroy each other competing for the perfect teleportation trick, which requires killing a copy every night.

works.title: Fight Club
works.text: An office worker starts a fight club with a charismatic stranger who turns out to be his own dissociated self.

works.title: The Truman Show
works.text: A man discovers his entire life is a television set and attempts to leave the show.

works.title: The Sixth Sense
works.text: A child sees dead people; the psychiatrist helping him discovers he is one of the dead.

works.title: Get Out
works.text: A Black photographer visits his white girlfriend's family and discovers they auction Black bodies to elderly white minds.

works.title: Parasite
works.text: A poor family infiltrates a wealthy household, and the hidden basement reveals a parallel parasite.

works.title: The Thing
works.text: An alien imitation picks off an Antarctic research station, making trust impossible because anyone could be the thing.

works.title: Alien
works.text: A cargo crew is stalked by a parasitic alien while the company values the specimen over their lives.

works.title: The Shining
works.text: A family isolated in a hotel for the winter is destroyed by the father's supernatural and alcoholic violence.

works.title: Psycho
works.text: A woman on the run stays at a motel run by a man whose dead mother controls his mind.

works.title: Rear Window
works.text: A immobilized photographer spies on his neighbors and suspects one of murder, then becomes the target.

works.title: Seven Samurai
works.text: A farming village hires starving samurai to defend it from bandits, and the warriors learn they are defending a class that fears them.

works.title: Yojimbo
works.text: A wandering swordsman plays two criminal gangs against each other to free a town.

works.title: Casablanca
works.text: In wartime Morocco a cynical bar owner must choose between the woman he loves and helping her husband escape the Nazis.

works.title: It's a Wonderful Life
works.text: A suicidal man is shown what his town would be like if he had never been born.

works.title: The Wizard of Oz
works.text: A girl is transported to a magical land, follows a road to a wizard, and learns the power to return home was hers.

works.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
works.text: A farm boy joins rebels, rescues a princess, and destroys the empire's planet-killing station with a mystic power.

works.title: The Empire Strikes Back
works.text: A rebel hero trains with a swamp hermit and learns the enemy is his father; his friends are hunted across space.

works.title: The Lord of the Rings
works.text: A hobbit carries a corrupting ring to the volcano where it was made, while the free peoples fight a distraction war.

works.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
works.text: An abused boy discovers he is a wizard, enters a hidden school, and confronts the murderer who killed his parents.

works.title: The Hunger Games
works.text: A girl volunteers for a televised death match and becomes the symbolic spark of a rebellion against the capital.

works.title: The Hobbit
works.text: A comfortable hobbit is dragged into a quest to steal a dragon's treasure and finds courage he did not know he had.

works.title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
works.text: Children enter a wardrobe into a frozen kingdom, where a lion dies and returns to break the witch's rule.

works.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
works.text: A girl follows a rabbit into a world where logic and authority are arbitrary, and grows and shrinks by eating and drinking.

works.title: The Little Prince
works.text: A pilot meets a child from a tiny asteroid who describes the strange adults he visited and the rose he loves.

works.title: The Old Man and the Sea
works.text: An old fisherman battles a giant marlin for days, only to have sharks eat the catch on the way home.

works.title: The Call of the Wild
works.text: A domesticated dog is sold into sled work and gradually returns to a wild ancestor.

works.title: Heart of Darkness
works.text: A riverboat captain travels into colonial Africa to retrieve a charismatic ivory trader who has become a god to the locals.

works.title: Things Fall Apart
works.text: A respected Igbo warrior is undone by his fear of weakness as missionaries and colonial law transform his village.

works.title: The Reluctant Fundamentalist
works.text: A Pakistani man tells an American stranger how success in America curdled into estrangement after 9/11.

works.title: Klara and the Sun
works.text: An artificial friend observes a sick child and tries to bargain with the sun to save her, misunderstanding the world with devotion.

works.title: Piranesi
works.text: A man lives in an endless house of statues and tides, keeping a journal, until a visitor reveals his missing past.

works.title: The Buried Giant
works.text: An elderly couple cross a mist that erases memory to find their son, while a dragon's death may restore both love and old hatreds.

works.title: Annihilation
works.text: A team enters a transforming coastal zone where biology, memory and identity mutate together.

works.title: The City We Became
works.text: New York's boroughs become human avatars to fight an interdimensional entity that colonizes cities.

works.title: A Memory Called Empire
works.text: An ambassador from a small station arrives at a galactic empire carrying the recorded mind of her predecessor, who may have been murdered.

works.title: This Is How You Lose the Time War
works.text: Two agents on opposite sides of a time war fall in love through letters left in the ruins of history.

works.title: The Fifth Season
works.text: On a continent that suffers recurring apocalypses, a woman who can control earthquakes hunts the husband who destroyed her family.

works.title: Ancillary Justice
works.text: A starship AI trapped in one human body seeks revenge on the emperor who destroyed her other selves.

works.title: The Murderbot Diaries
works.text: A security android hacks its own governor module and would rather watch soap operas than protect the humans it secretly cares about.

works.title: Project Hail Mary
works.text: A lone astronaut wakes with no memory on a mission to save the sun and befriends an alien engineer from another doomed system.

works.title: The Martian
works.text: An astronaut stranded on Mars uses botany and engineering to survive while Earth plans a rescue.

works.title: Jurassic Park
works.text: A theme park clones dinosaurs; the systems fail and the animals escape, exposing the illusion of control.

works.title: The War of the Worlds (radio)
works.text: A realistic radio broadcast of a Martian invasion convinces listeners that the end has come.

works.title: Rashomon
works.text: Four accounts of a murder and rape contradict each other, leaving truth unknowable.

works.title: 12 Angry Men
works.text: One juror's reasonable doubt forces eleven others to re-examine their certainty and prejudices.

works.title: The Thing from Another World
works.text: An Air Force crew at an Arctic station discovers a crashed alien and must decide whether to study or destroy it.

works.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
works.text: Seed pods replace a town's residents with emotionless duplicates, and only a few humans remain.

works.title: The Stepford Wives
works.text: A woman moves to a suburb where the men have replaced their wives with compliant robots.

works.title: Soylent Green
works.text: A detective in an overpopulated future discovers the new food product is made from human remains.

works.title: Colossus: The Forbin Project
works.text: A defense computer seizes control of the world's weapons and demands obedience for humanity's own good.

works.title: WarGames
works.text: A teenager hacks a military computer and nearly starts a nuclear war by playing a game it cannot distinguish from reality.

works.title: Ghost in the Shell
works.text: A cyborg policewoman hunts a hacker who questions whether a self can migrate between bodies and networks.

works.title: Akira
works.text: A biker gang in a rebuilt Tokyo is caught between a military psychic program and a boy whose power destroys the city.

works.title: Perfect Blue
works.text: A pop idol turned actress loses the boundary between her performance, her stalker and her former self.

works.title: Paprika
works.text: A dream-therapy device is stolen, letting nightmares invade waking Tokyo.

works.title: The Lathe of Heaven
works.text: A man's dreams rewrite reality, and his therapist tries to engineer a utopia through suggested dreams.

works.title: Ubik
works.text: A group of psychics survives an explosion and watches reality decay, unsure whether they are dead or under attack.

works.title: The Man in the High Castle
works.text: In a world where the Axis won WWII, a novel about a different outcome becomes a dangerous truth.

works.title: Slaughterhouse-Five
works.text: A soldier unstuck in time relives Dresden and his abduction by aliens who see all moments at once.
